app.name: Dala Safe
app.tagline: Prepare your trip. Share your safety plan. Know what to do when conditions change.
app.description: A mobile-first trip preparation and safety-planning tool for outdoor trips in Kazakhstan.
error.storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Your changes may not be saved.
error.storageQuota: Local storage is full. Export or delete some trips to continue.
error.storageCorrupted: Some locally stored data could not be read and was skipped.
error.generic: Please try again. If the problem continues, reload the app.
language.label: Language
home.title: Prepare before you head outdoors
home.lead: Build a trip plan, finish a readiness checklist, share it with someone you trust, and keep essential guidance available offline.
home.card.prepare.title: Prepare
home.card.prepare.body: Record route, timing, group size and notes in one place.
home.card.share.title: Share
home.card.share.body: Generate a clear message for a trusted contact. Sending is always your action.
home.card.offline.title: Stay ready offline
home.card.offline.body: Essential guidance remains available when connectivity drops.
home.recent.title: Recent trips
home.recent.empty: No trips yet. Create your first trip to begin.
home.limits.title: Important limits
home.limits.body: Dala Safe is not an emergency dispatch service, a certified navigation system, or a rescue guarantee. It does not monitor you and does not contact rescuers automatically. Follow official emergency guidance.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.description: The interface supports Kazakh, Russian and English. Your choice is stored on this device only.
settings.data.title: Your data
settings.data.description: Trip data stays in this browser on this device. It is not synchronized across devices.
settings.about.title: About Dala Safe
settings.about.body: Dala Safe helps travelers prepare and share a safety plan. It does not replace official instructions or rescue services.
settings.translation.title: Translation status
settings.translation.body: Kazakh and Russian safety text is machine-assisted until reviewed by a competent speaker. Items requiring review are marked in the source documentation.
settings.pwa.title: Installation
settings.pwa.body: You can install Dala Safe from your browser menu. Offline access works after the first successful load.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you opened does not exist. Return home to continue.
featureStatus.available.description: Implemented and tested for the stated functionality.
featureStatus.demo.description: Interactive demonstration using sample data or simulated behaviour.
featureStatus.planned.description: Proposed for a later phase; not part of the working MVP.
featureStatus.requires-integration.descr: Depends on an external service, backend, permission or agreement.
featureStatus.needs-verification.descrip: Requires authoritative review or validation before release.
settings.pwa.updateAvailable: A new version is available. Reload to update.
footer.tagline: Dala Safe helps you prepare for a trip. It is not a dispatch or rescue service.
